[!!!! This project is in pre-alpha state !!!!]

[=What is SPO=]

SPO is a [*zero-trust*] programming language focused on security, safety, robustness, and performance.

[((And by the way, this properties make it also grate for agent coding.))]

[=Why SPO=]

Modern software runs critical infrastructure, but the most current production languages make it still easy to ship:
- null references exceptions,
- out of range issues with array indexing,
- and hidden side effects.

This kind of issues threading the security, relatability and maintainability of current software.

SPO will not allow this kind of failures by design.

[=Design goals=]

- Strict memory safety and type safety.
- Make common runtime failures impossible like null dereferences and out-of-range access.
- Keep mutable state explicit by capability-based access instead of allowing hidden global effects.
- Make static dataflow analysis straightforward.
- Allow the coexist of functional, imperative and concurrent programming paradigms.

[=Repository Layout=]

This repository currently contains a C# implementation of the language and some tooling:
- a HTML based viewer for the wiki docs
-- a simple HTTP server (to test the wiki doc locally)
- a VSCode extension to support the files formats:
-- .spo (the programming language source file format)
-- .ilt (the intermediate language in text format)
-- .wiki (the custom documentation markup language)

[| [*Path*]                     ][ [*Purpose*]                                                                             |]
[| [.|SPO_CS/.]                 ][ main implementation: tokenizer, parser, AST, typing, lowering, VM, modules, and tests   |]
[| [.|index.html.] and [.|js/.] ][ local viewer for [.|.wiki.], [.|.spo.], [.|.ilt.], diagrams, images, and related assets |]
[| [.|doc/.]                    ][ documentation in the repository's custom [.|.wiki.] format                              |]
[| [.|VSCode_Extension/.]       ][ VS Code client, language server source                                                  |]

[=Prerequisites=]

- Windows (only the performance measurement from the tests depends on windows)
- .NET 11 SDK pinned in [<../global.json>]

[=Run Tests=]

[.sh
|> dotnet SPO_CS/src/mRunTests.cs

[=Planned Killer App=]

A plugin-driven, secure, privacy-first social media infrastructure without mandatory central servers.

Untrusted extensions would run under explicit capabilities, and user data would stay user-hosted unless deliberately delegated elsewhere.

[=Roadmap=]

[*Pre-Alpha -> Alpha:*]
- make the compiler self-hosting by rewriting it in SPO.

[*Alpha -> Beta:*]
- complete memory management and missing core features such as refinement types, parallel execution, and debugger support.

[*Beta -> Release:*]
- add real CPU backends such as LLVM and expand tooling plus standard libraries.
